title: Audit sheet reuse in preparations
description: Snapshot the sheet-instance identity, exact layout revision, used-position state, and fresh reuse confirmation into each immutable PrintPreparation.
acceptanceCriteria: Preparation records exact instance ID, layout identity/revision, canonical used-position snapshot, and confirmation record
The saved snapshot exactly matches omission inputs used for preview/PDF generation
Later instance edits or deletion policy cannot alter historical preparation data
Missing or stale confirmation causes atomic refusal with no preparation or PDF artifact

steps.details: Add optional versioned SheetReuseAudit fields to immutable TASK-32/TASK-75 preparation schema.
At generation, atomically capture exact instance/revision, canonical used positions, omission plan identity, and fresh consumed confirmation.
Show the recorded instance state and limitation disclosure in preparation details without a safety status.
Test exact plan/audit equivalence, later instance mutation, stale confirmation, failed-write atomicity, reload, and parsed PDF omissions.

technicalNotes: Maximum execution scope is ten minutes; extend the preparation snapshot and focused immutability fixtures only.
Historical audit records document operator inputs; they do not prove that printing occurred.
Preserve canonical position ordering in the snapshot.
